title: Bloom
tagline: The Bloomberg terminal for trading with AI agents — chat to buy, sell, and track assets live
description:
A smart helper answers you and at the same time builds clear, live pictures on the screen for you price charts, market lists, your money balances, and simple trade boxes with a Confirm button.

You can watch live prices move second by second, pause or switch what you are watching, and see a full history of all your past trades in one small floating box. For safety, there is a practice mode where you start with play money.

In short, it turns confusing trading work into a calm conversation with live pictures, a practice playground, and one-click real actions.
how_its_made: This project used privy wallet for auth, sub-graph for sub second real time data and uniswap api for trading and executing trades. And open ai, openUi for agents and real time UI generation for interaction and agents trade. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS frontend.   Substreams for live prices. PostgreSQL + Redis for state and caching.
auto_summary: A Next.js trading assistant combines AI chat, live market data, wallet actions, and Uniswap trade execution into a conversational interface.
